{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue to avoid silent errors (though not used here)
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
df_qa = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Check which of these are loyal customers
df_qa_loyal = df_qa[df_qa['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']
print(f"Number of QA orders that are loyal: {len(df_qa_loyal)}")
print("QA loyal order sample:", df_qa_loyal[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status', 'revenue', 'converted']].head())"}
